title: Synthetic kinase inhibitor proteome response in organoid culture

findings.title: Protein-level FDR is not reported
findings.evidence: The packet reports peptide FDR but no protein-level false-discovery threshold.
findings.remediation: Report protein-level FDR control, decoy counting rules, and protein-group inference settings before accepting protein abundance claims.

findings.title: Protein claims rely on weak unique-peptide support
findings.evidence: 2 protein group(s) have fewer than two unique peptides or are dominated by razor/shared peptides.
findings.remediation: Require unique-peptide evidence, protein-group ambiguity flags, or claim wording that reflects indistinguishable protein families.

findings.title: Batch structure is confounded with biological condition
findings.remediation: Randomize run order or model batch explicitly; treat condition-level abundance claims as provisional until batch sensitivity is shown.

findings.title: Retention-time drift lacks calibration evidence
findings.evidence: Median shift is 38 seconds and no calibration standard is listed.
findings.remediation: Add pooled QC trend plots, retention-time alignment diagnostics, and acceptance thresholds for instrument drift.

findings.title: Missing intensity handling can inflate differential abundance
findings.remediation: Use left-censoring-aware imputation or sensitivity analyses; avoid zero-fill-driven significance claims.

findings.title: PTM localization confidence is absent
findings.evidence: Phosphorylation is searched, but no site-localization probability threshold is provided.
findings.remediation: Report localization score thresholds and site ambiguity before claiming a direct kinase substrate.

findings.title: Biological replicate count is low for broad pathway claims
findings.evidence: 3 biological replicates per condition are listed.
findings.remediation: Limit claims to exploratory evidence or add independent biological replication.

findings.title: Raw data and search parameters are not reproducible
findings.evidence: The packet lacks a repository accession, raw-file deposition, or full search-parameter export.
findings.remediation: Provide raw files, peak lists where applicable, search-parameter exports, and a stable ProteomeXchange-style accession.

findings.title: Narrative claims exceed statistical support
findings.evidence: 1 protein-level claim(s) use strong wording despite adjusted p-values at or above 0.05.
findings.remediation: Align claim language with adjusted p-values, effect sizes, and confidence intervals.

safeSummary: Synthetic proteomics evidence is not ready for strong AI-generated conclusions until FDR, protein-group ambiguity, batch design, missingness, PTM localization, and reproducibility gaps are resolved.
